items.title: Revenue at Palantir-Backed Ondas Rises 1,236%. Stock Falls as Losses Widen.
items.summary: Shares of  Ondas  declined Thursday after the autonomous drone maker  and  Palantir  partner posted a wider-than-expected second-quarter loss, overshadowing a more than 1,200% increase in revenue.  Ondas stock dropped 8% to $8.98 on Thursday after ending Wednesday up 0.3%.  The West Palm Beach, Fla.,-based provider of artificial intelligence-powered autonomous drone systems posted second-quarter revenue of $83.77 million, increasing 1,236% from $6.27 million a year ago and above Wall Street’s call for $68 million.
